CashBook.title: CashBook
CashBook.description: Represents an independent business cash book or ledger register owned by a user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this cash book.

name.description: Display title of the cash book (1 to 80 chars).

description.description: Optional subtitle or notes for the cash book (0 to 200 chars).

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol used for amounts in this book, e.g. ₹ or $ (1 to 10 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cash book was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cash book was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Party.title: Party
Party.description: Represents a customer, supplier, or staff contact linked to ledger vouchers.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this party record.

name.description: Name of the customer, supplier, or staff member (1 to 80 chars).

phone.description: Phone number or contact info (0 to 30 chars).

notes.description: Additional ledger notes or GST/account info (0 to 250 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the party was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the party was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CashTransaction.title: CashTransaction
CashTransaction.description: Represents a Cash In (receipt) or Cash Out (payment) voucher entry inside a cash book.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this voucher.

bookId.description: Document ID of the parent CashBook.

remark.description: Particulars or voucher narration (0 to 250 chars).

category.description: Head of account / expense or income category (1 to 60 chars).

partyId.description: Optional linked Party document ID (empty string if unlinked).

partyName.description: Denormalized party name for display and statement export (empty string if unlinked).

transactionDate.description: Epoch milliseconds representing the voucher date and time.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the voucher was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the voucher was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/cashbooks/{bookId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing independent business cash books.

/users/{userId}/parties/{partyId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing customer, supplier, and staff party accounts.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing Cash In and Cash Out ledger vouchers.
